title: Self-reference × style × imagery — factorial feasibility pilot
hypothesis: Self-reference is associated with increased turn-2 repetition, with possible interactions with lyrical style and supplied imagery.
primary_outcome: Turn-2 repeated four-gram fraction, analyzed separately by model; descriptive factorial contrasts averaged over variants and seed blocks.
analysis_plan: Report all runs, errors, cutoffs and exclusions. Compare factor levels within model, blocking by prompt variant and seed. Report repetition, word counts, and exact recovery rates. Length-matched sensitivity analysis required before causal interpretation. No confirmatory significance claims from this pilot. Human labels are secondary.
sample_size_justification: Three seed blocks and two prompt variants per factorial cell test feasibility only. Use separate pilot variance estimates and a prespecified meaningful effect to plan a later powered study.
